title: Statue of Unity
visualBrief: Build the recognizable full sculpted human form, not a generic human mannequin, capsule or extruded photographic silhouette. Match Patel bald head, broad ears/nose/chin, heavy asymmetric draped jacket/scarf, long dhoti folds, lowered hands and narrow walking-leg gap, broad sandaled toes and intrinsic stepped pedestal/real entrance/geometric perforated panel. Use original closed shaped cross sections and sculpted surfaces with canonical bronze metal and stone; all hidden fine wrinkles, exact back pose and fold census remain estimates. Primary 182 m controls statue height; podium vertical section is a separate bounded estimate, and promotional 240/58 m statements are not adopted as a measured local above-entry section. Preserve intrinsic original native outlines. Exclude terrain/island/long bridges/independent buildings. Freeze independent terrain before geometry.

geographicProposal.notes: Complete exterior of the 182 m Sardar Patel sculpture and its intrinsic stepped geometric pedestal/entry shell: bald head and facial profile, jacket/shawl and dhoti folds, two walking legs with true gap, lowered hands, sandaled feet with toes, central upper support and original podium/entry outlines with actual openings and geometric lattice ramp. Exclude the separate mainland visitor buildings, the long river access bridges, island/river/hills/landscape, signs/flags/people, interior museum and mechanical cores.
